non-linear inductor (transformer) is in series with capacitor

questions.question: Lightning surges are characterized by

questions.tutor: Surge arresters clamp the voltage to a safe level by diverting surge current to ground.

choices: traveling wave reflections on transmission lines
questions.tutor: Bewley lattice diagram tracks traveling wave reflections and refractions at line discontinuities.

questions.question: The characteristic impedance of a lossless transmission line is

questions.tutor: v = 1/√(LC) ≈ speed of light (3×10⁸ m/s) for overhead lines.

questions.tutor: Zero-state response occurs with zero initial conditions, only external sources applied.

questions.question: Recovery voltage in a circuit breaker is
choices: steady-state voltage after transients die out
questions.tutor: Recovery voltage is the power-frequency voltage that appears across breaker contacts after transient oscillations subside.
